terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) govern the use of the NImageManager image-management service (the “Service”) provided by NImageManager Operations (the “Operator”). You may use the Service only after agreeing to these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
terms.account.title: 1. Accounts
terms.account.email: You must register an accurate email address that you are authorized to use and complete the verification process.
terms.account.credentials: You are responsible for safeguarding your authentication credentials and must not allow a third party to use them.
terms.account.minors: Where required by law, minors must obtain consent from a parent or other legal representative before using the Service.
terms.account.abuse: Fraudulent registration, impersonation, evasion of restrictions through multiple accounts, and other misuse are prohibited.
terms.upload.title: 2. Data You May Upload
terms.upload.own: You may upload only data that you created yourself and for which you personally hold all rights required to upload and use it with the Service.
terms.upload.third_party: Uploading any image, material, or data in which a third party holds copyright, neighboring rights, trademark rights, portrait rights, privacy rights, or any other rights is strictly prohibited.
terms.upload.harmful: You must not upload illegal or harmful data, data intended for unauthorized access, malware, or any other data that interferes with operation of the Service.
terms.upload.warranty: You represent that you hold all required rights in uploaded data and are responsible for resolving any dispute with a third party.
terms.data.title: 3. Rights in Uploaded Data and Development Use
terms.data.rights: You retain all rights in uploaded data. The Operator does not acquire ownership or copyright in it.
terms.data.development: The Operator may view, copy, analyze, or temporarily process uploaded data only to the extent necessary to develop and improve NImageManager, including reproducing and investigating defects, verifying operation, improving features, implementing security measures, and performing anonymized or aggregated statistical analysis.
terms.data.no_training: The Operator does not use uploaded data to train AI or machine-learning models and does not provide it to third parties except where required by law or to service providers necessary to deliver the Service.
terms.sharing.title: 4. Sharing and List Thumbnails
terms.sharing.enabled: If you enable sharing for a work, authorized users may be able to view its details, detailed thumbnail, or original file.
terms.sharing.list_thumbnail: Low-resolution list thumbnails are delivered through hard-to-guess public URLs. Anyone who knows a URL may be able to access the corresponding list thumbnail directly, regardless of sign-in or sharing status.
terms.sharing.review: You must review your sharing settings and uploaded content before using the Service.
terms.prohibited.title: 5. Prohibited Conduct and Suspension
terms.prohibited.body: Infringement of rights, violations of law, harassment, attacks on or analysis of the Service, excessive load, circumvention of authentication or access controls, and registration of false information are prohibited. If the Operator reasonably determines that a violation has occurred or may occur, it may delete data, restrict functions, or suspend or delete an account without prior notice.
terms.withdrawal.title: 6. Account Deletion
terms.withdrawal.body: You may delete your account from the settings page after signing in. Account deletion removes the originals, derivative images, thumbnails, metadata, bookmarks, and other related data you uploaded, and that data cannot be restored. Except for minimum records required by law or for incident and abuse response, the Operator does not guarantee recovery after deletion.
terms.service.title: 7. Changes, Interruptions, and Termination
terms.service.body: The Operator may change, interrupt, or terminate all or part of the Service for maintenance, failures, security requirements, legal compliance, or other reasons. You are responsible for backing up any data you need.
terms.liability.title: 8. Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability
terms.liability.as_is: The Service is provided as is. The Operator does not warrant continuity, completeness, accuracy, fitness for a particular purpose, preservation of data, or freedom from failures or unauthorized access.
terms.liability.limit: To the extent permitted by law, the Operator is not liable for and will not compensate losses resulting from loss, leakage, corruption, or third-party use of data, or from use of or inability to use the Service.
terms.liability.exception: The preceding limitation does not apply where exclusion or limitation of liability is not permitted by law, including cases involving intentional misconduct or gross negligence by the Operator.
terms.changes.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
terms.changes.body: The Operator may revise these Terms in response to changes in law or the Service. Material changes will be announced through the Service, and renewed consent will be requested where appropriate.
terms.law.title: 10. Governing Law
terms.law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. If a dispute arises, you and the Operator will seek to resolve it through good-faith consultation.
terms.contact.title: 11. Contact
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NImageManager Operations (the “Operator”) handles user information in the NImageManager image-management service (the “Service”) as described below.
privacy.collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacy.collection.account: Account information: username, email address, email-verification date and time, and the versions and date and time of agreed terms and policies
privacy.collection.auth: Authentication information: hashed password, authentication tokens, and, when Google sign-in is used, the Google account identifier and verified email address
privacy.collection.content: Information you store: original images, derivative images such as thumbnails, generation information, prompts, tags and other metadata embedded in images, bookmarks, and sharing settings
privacy.collection.usage: Usage information: access date and time, IP address, browser and device information, and operation, error, and security logs
privacy.collection.contact: Information you provide when contacting us
privacy.purpose.title: 2. Purposes of Use
privacy.purpose.account: Identity verification, sign-in, email verification, password reset, and account administration
privacy.purpose.service: Providing image management, sharing, search, thumbnail generation, and other Service features
privacy.purpose.contact: Responding to inquiries and sending important notices
privacy.purpose.security: Detecting, preventing, and investigating misuse and maintaining security
privacy.purpose.development: Developing and improving NImageManager, including reproducing and investigating defects, verifying operation, improving features, and analyzing anonymized or aggregated usage
privacy.purpose.no_training: The Operator does not use uploaded data to train AI or machine-learning models.
privacy.sharing.title: 3. Information Made Public or Shared
privacy.sharing.enabled: If you enable sharing for a work, authorized users may be able to view its image, details, or metadata.
privacy.sharing.list_thumbnail: Low-resolution list thumbnails are delivered without authentication through hard-to-guess URLs. Anyone who knows a URL may be able to view the corresponding thumbnail directly, regardless of sharing settings.
privacy.sharing.caution: Take care not to include personal information or information affecting third-party rights in images or metadata.
privacy.providers.title: 4. External Services and Service Providers
privacy.providers.body: To the extent necessary to provide the Service, the Operator may use Sakura Internet for email delivery, Google for Google sign-in, and hosting or network providers for communication and public access. Email addresses, authentication information, IP addresses, and other necessary information may be transmitted to those providers and processed under their respective terms and privacy policies.
privacy.third_party.title: 5. Disclosure to Third Parties
privacy.third_party.body: The Operator does not disclose personal data to third parties except with your consent, as required by law, when necessary to protect a person’s life, body, or property, or when a provider described above processes it as necessary to deliver the Service.
privacy.retention.title: 6. Retention and Deletion
privacy.retention.period: The Operator retains information for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes of use or for any period required by law.
privacy.retention.deletion: When you delete your account from the settings page, the Operator deletes the account and its uploaded originals, derivative images, public thumbnails, metadata, bookmarks, and other related data. Deleted data cannot be restored.
privacy.retention.exceptions: Security and incident-investigation logs, records required by law, and limited backups already created when deletion is processed may remain for the minimum necessary period.
privacy.cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Similar Technologies
privacy.cookies.body: The Service stores authentication information in an HTTP-only cookie to maintain your signed-in session. It also processes access information to prevent misuse and maintain stable operation.
privacy.security.title: 8. Security Measures
privacy.security.body: The Operator implements reasonable security measures appropriate to the information handled, including access controls, password hashing, and protection of communication paths. However, it does not guarantee that leakage, loss, or corruption of information can be completely prevented.
privacy.rights.title: 9. Access, Correction, Suspension, and Deletion
privacy.rights.body: In accordance with applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, suspension of use of, or deletion of your retained personal data. The Operator will respond after verifying your identity. You can also delete your account from the settings page after signing in.
privacy.minors.title: 10. Minors
privacy.minors.body: Where required by law, minors must obtain consent from a parent or other legal representative before using the Service.
privacy.changes.title: 11. Changes
privacy.changes.body: The Operator may revise this Policy in response to changes in law or the Service. Material changes will be announced through the Service, and renewed consent will be requested where appropriate.
privacy.contact.title: 12. Contact
